vb_textbox.text: At first I didn't have a strategy, but then I matched up colours of the gnomes (brown and purple were shown together, and red and green), so I chose red when I chose brown. If one of them started to produce less mushrooms, I chose the other colour, and eventually the other colour for both (I chose red and brown gnomes and then green and purple). This seemed to create a pattern and earned me a lot of points.
